actdesc: The final step on the twisting stairwell of apprenticeship.
needtext: Master refuses to teach you more until you clear out the Leaky Cellar.

log.name: Neophyte
log.desc: Your master has decided you are ready to take the next step on the path of wizardry.

flavor: Why does Master charge so many fees?

name: Tier 0 - Solitary Magic
desc: Some say the study of magic doesn't truly begin until apprenticeship ends. People say a lot of things.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 1 - Professional Magick
desc: Every province has its handful of runaway apprentices and failed Adepts. It's not uncommon for thieves and rangers to know a spell or two. They are nothing compared to the talents of a true professional.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 2 - Arcane Ascendant
desc: The masses of arcane dabblers never reach such heights.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 3 - Magical Mastery
desc: You are a master of your field of magic.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 4 - Supreme Sorcery
desc: Not even the masters could challenge you.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 5 - Dhrunic Magic
desc: Magic from a forgotten age.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement.

name: Tier 6 - Ageless Magic
desc: Ages of the world come and go; only these endure.
needtext: Will be acquired with your next class advancement

name: Graduand Magus
desc: Having established a proper foundation of magical knowledge for further specialization, there is little your master can still teach you.
needtext: Complete all 4 Tier 0 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Erudition
desc: Going through all of your master's simpler texts, you have sufficiently grasped the fundamentals of magic.
needtext: Purchase Library Haul 4 times.

name: Equestrian
desc: More interesting locales are much too far away to walk on foot, you will need the assistance of your trusty steed to go any further.
needtext: Purchase a steed.

name: Night Owl
desc: The time you are currently wasting in bed could be just as well-spent as any waking moment. Magically hasten your mind's recovery to save those precious hours.

name: Spellcaster
desc: You can finally express the fruits of your study by manipulating mana into spells for adventuring.
needtext: Construct a spelllist by memorizing learnt spells.

name: Mana Proficiency
desc: Despite having just recently graduated, your thirst for knowledge knowns no end. You are now proficient in magic use.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 1 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Energy Spectrum
desc: The various prismatic magics develop from raw mana taking to natural phenomena. Channel them all within your body to further your research.
needtext: Learn all the prismatic mana types, consisting of standard mana, the 4 elemental, and 4 primal forces. You will need to purchase upgrades to act as a source for the respective mana type to unlock the corresponding skills.

name: Root Out Banditry
desc: You spotted a thief hideout nearby while exploring. It'd be wise to nip this threat in the bud before they learn of your wealth.
flavor: No foul if you steal from a thief.

name: Uncover The Crypt
desc: An ominous ancient burial site near your maps' periphery remains mostly uncharted to this day. Explore what lies within.
flavor: Looks old enough to be archaeology instead of grave-robbing.

name: Home Sweet Home
desc: Lodging at this seedy inn with its overpriced room rate is a temporary necessity. Go prospect other abodes.
needtext: Move out of the Inn to more permanent housing.

name: Enchanted Scrollery
desc: It is simply not practical to painstakingly scribe all these hundreds of scrolls. You have heard that experienced mages delegate this responsibility to their looms.
flavor: A hands off approach to research.
needtext: Learn how to automate scroll production. This requires the Weaving skill.

name: Well-Armed
desc: While peppering your foes with arcane blasts or wielding training gear seems to still do the trick, your combat power could reach another level with a proper weapon.
needtext: Equip a non-training weapon you have crafted.

name: Arcane Expertise
desc: Surpassing even most professional mages, your arcane prowess is regarded as remarkable.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 2 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Prismatic Rift
desc: The realm of pure elements is sure to provide rich rewards to those capable of slaying the native elementals.
flavor: Where do they find the gemstones?

name: Vesparia's Gilded Age
desc: The bustling markets of Vesparia's capital attract both the best and worst of society. It is time to make your foray into Reedburgh's commercial sector.
needtext: Explore Reedburgh Markets. You will need a Reedburgh City Pass to be allowed entry, which requires the City Navigation skill.

name: Thaumaturgy
desc: One of the principal applications of magic, enchanting is the most essential skill for a wizard to further progress.
needtext: Learn the enchanting skill and possess at least one of each of the 9 prismatic gem types.

name: Bubbling Concoctions
desc: Philtres of all varieties, typically used to apply either long-lasting buffs or powerful instant effects. Useful for a wizard looking to optimize.
needtext: Brew your first potion. The Potions skill requires Alchemy.

name: Mercantile Ventures
desc: Your experimental ventures seem to be costing ever-increasing amounts of gold. You will need to look at methods to finance further research.
needtext: Learn Shopkeeping. Requires 1000 gold to unlock.

name: Alignment Bias
desc: Even the moral character of a wizard is capable of deeply influencing their magical capabilities. Take another step down your chosen path.
needtext: Select your Tier 1 morality. Options include Scrupulous for good, Sinister for evil, and either Balanced or Detached for neutrality. You can refer to the glossary for further information.

name: Preeminent Magus
desc: The capacity for magic most can only dream to reach after a lifetime of study. You are now amongst the most talented of your generation.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 3 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Tattered Cobwebs
desc: Monstrous spiders dwell in that infested cave, luring adventurers to their swathed demise. However, their silk is of excellent quality for crafting gear.

name: Mountain Trekking
desc: One of the most dangerous climbs in all of Dhrune with threats abound for any would-be mountaineer. At its peak, you feel on top of the world.

name: Fazbit's Magnum Opus
desc: The workshop of the legendary alchemist said to have come closest to crafting the philosopher's stone. Despite having degraded, you can still glean a great deal of wisdom from Fazbit's experiments.

name: Ghost Writer
desc: It is common for powerful wizards to bind lesser spirits to perform menial tasks. These chained spirits greatly enhance your production of texts.
needtext: Have 12 Unseen Scribes.

name: Gematria
desc: Further hidden meanings lie beneath a magical text's surface, enchant your grimoires to decode these arcane ciphers.
needtext: Enchant your Personal Study.

name: Esoteric Occultist
desc: Your magical might is deemed nearly inhuman, exceeding what is believed to be possible for a mortal to achieve.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 4 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Bibliophile
desc: Your body of work has grown so voluminous it now needs to be stored in a great library.

name: Ruins of Reverence
desc: Challenge the encroaching inhabitants dwelling within the grand temple of the Seredites.
flavor: What gods did they worship? How did they show devotion? Only the sea knows now.

name: Echo of the Ages
desc: Where some of the greatest mages in history continue researching in isolation, having long since severed all worldly ties.

name: Timeline Bifurcation
desc: Similar to how a river fragments into lesser streams, you have split your own time in twain, now capable of performing multiple actions simultaneously.
needtext: Gain an additional action slot from Timesplit while possessing 5 Chronomancy.

name: Spell Construction
desc: It is regarded as a rite of passage for truly capable mages to begin creating spells of their own design.
needtext: Learn Spellcraft.

name: Runic Labourers
desc: Specialized in nothing but runesmithing, they charge a more than fair price per rune stone.
needtext: Hire either a Dwarven Runecrafter or Skeletal Runecarver. Requires Runic Lore.

name: Magic Immemorial
desc: A level of wizardry seen only in myths, chalked up as little more than fairy tales. Yet still, you aim towards a step even further beyond.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 5 Quests. Attain a permanent transformation. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Disaster's Emissaries
desc: At the heart of the elemental realm, clash against the greater elementals worthy of the moniker of 'disaster'.

name: Den of Pleasure
desc: Where Desilla's harem still lays together in happy union. Bring about an end to their insidious playtime.

name: Endless Stamina
desc: Infusing magical vitality within your muscles, gain stamina far beyond human limits.
needtext: Learn Vivification.

name: Aerated Abode
desc: Perpetual magical cooling allows you to continuously perform experiments with minimal exhaustion.

name: Realm Splitter
desc: A marvel of magical engineering, a nexus serves as the highest application of planes magic - acting as a permanent gateway to distant realms.

name: Eternal Transcendence
desc: Unfathomable power yet dedicating this eternity to even further research. You are the strongest a wizard can hope of being.
needtext: Complete at least 4 Tier 6 Quests. Necessary for your next class advancement.

name: Ashen Glory
desc: It is a rare opportunity to be able to fight one of the infamous Archlocks. Slay the greatest butcher of men in history who still stalks these lands.

name: Dunes of Orrem
desc: The lone and level sands stretch far away, all that remains of Orrem's great cities. Utterly inhospitable, it still echoes the magic of that mighty state.

name: Stare Back
desc: The void beckons. Grasp how to mould it into useful positive and negative space.
needtext: Learn Abyss Gazing.

name: Wish Upon A Star
desc: Arcane secrets lie scattered across the heavens, hidden in plain sight.
needtext: Be capable of storing 5 star shards. Requires Astral Communion.

name: Pocket Dimension
desc: Through careful utilisation of your Dhrunic Nexus, you can construct planes of various magical energies. This would prove invaluable for further storage.

name: Wizard Association
desc: A wizard's hall is where the mightiest mages gather, exchanging the most guarded of secrets amongst each other. Truly unstoppable as a combined force.
